name: Volt City
status: Gate 1 passed 2026-09-26 (owner picked T1 Volt City, must be 3D); brief written; name under review (collides with Volt Casino's 'Volt City'); core build starting

notes.name: WebSearch 2026-09-26: 'Volt City' is an existing meta-game of Volt Casino (Malta), previewed at SiGMA 2019, with the same blackout premise. Rename recommended before submission (proposed: 'Storm Grid'). See docs/ORIGINALITY.md. Not legal advice.
notes.mouse-gesture: Click-to-target: the player presses on a rooftop, holds to charge and releases to strike; nothing follows mouse movement continuously, so CG-QUAL-008 does not require pointer lock ('click-on-UI games need no confinement'). The hold uses pointer capture, so a release outside the frame still fires the strike and cannot click the page.
notes.keyboard: Arrows / WASD (KeyboardEvent.code) move a crosshair between antennas; hold/release Space or Enter charges and strikes; P pause, M mute. Escape and Ctrl combos are never bound.
notes.banners: None in v1: menus are open under 5 s on average between 15-35 s runs, and banners are off in the CrazyGames app and Basic Launch.
notes.has-progress: Coins, current city, best plate per city, 5 upgrades, skins owned/tried, offer timestamps, daily gift day/streak and mute, saved via the CrazyGames Data module.
notes.has-accounts: No in-game accounts; guests play, and the Data module migrates guest progress on CrazyGames login.
notes.multiplayer: Single-player; no bots, no other players.
notes.rewarded: 7 surfaces, each with a cap and a coin or play path: Supercharged start, One more strike (once per session, 85-99% powered), Claim x3, free upgrade, shop cash, try a skin, daily gift x2 (docs/GAME_BRIEF.md).
notes.budgets: Profile M (skill references/threejs/visual-style.md). Enforced by tools/qa/browser-qa.mjs (poly-budget, dead-air) and tools/qa/check-poly.mjs. heroTriangles: at most ONE geometry may exceed trianglesPerGeometry, up to this.
